titles: Add supervisor daemon for repeated AFK episodes
planning_reasons: The loop can already plan and execute bounded episodes, but it still needs a persistent local operator that keeps relaunching those episodes while preserving review gates.
The planner currently creates new work with only titles and done conditions, so humans need explicit rationale to audit why each new task entered the queue.
Once planning and supervision exist, humans need a single status view that explains whether the system is actively working, waiting on a blocker, or cleanly idle.
